limits: One paid call, six native Choice questions. Each option is a SET of frames, including all subsets, none, and clarification. No Score, composite, repair calls or retries.

Jev sees informal Italian intents and a semantic catalog, not bridge IDs, coordinates, bindings, geometric availability or author annotations. Text only intentionally isolates routing; images have not been tested here.
Two frames refer to historical LOCAL contracts; congruence is an existing grammar proposal, not another historical GS. The catalog is three perspectives, not a Euclid corpus.

The same workspace is used for all six intents. Code executes only selected perspectives over three fixed prospective cuts. It checks historical local contracts and triangle SSS numerically; no new open-ended construction or formal theorem proof.
Author-authored synthetic intents and predeclared acceptable sets are a smoke test, not independent human validation, held-out paraphrase generalization or universal relevance truth.
The ambiguous intent has two acceptable actions (clarify or retain all). Multiple useful perspectives are encoded as a set option rather than selecting a winner from mutually exclusive single frames.

Baselines are a frozen exact-token-overlap heuristic and explore-all. Dispatch/check counts are deterministic work units, not measured latency, monetary savings or proof-search performance. Baselines make no paid calls.
A selected relevant frame can have no certified binding in the finite cut catalog. Report that separately from semantic routing errors. Code never manufactures a binding from a model choice.

All intents share one state/request and are correlated. No causal comparison with prior geometry tests, calibrated probabilities, autonomous discovery, visual comprehension or internal sequential reasoning is established.
Native probabilities/confidence/usage are retained; absent reliability is null. No confidence gate or threshold tuned after observing answers. Clarification/none are explicit returned options.

workspace.scope: One triangular host; prospective subdivisions may be explored by a separate code component.

F364.title: Corrispondenza di forma e dimensioni
F364.description: Cercare due regioni congruenti: sovrapponibili con traslazioni, rotazioni o riflessioni, senza deformazioni o cambi di scala. La sola adiacenza non basta.

F124.title: Confronto fra due triangoli sul carrier comune
F124.description: Confrontare due parti triangolari adiacenti organizzandole attorno al segmento materiale che condividono. Non richiede uguaglianza di forma o dimensioni.

F553.title: Identità dello stesso carrier in ruoli diversi
F553.description: Seguire lo stesso oggetto materiale nei diversi impieghi: bordo di ciascuna regione e separazione interna della figura intera. Il tema è la relazione fra parte, tutto e identità del carrier.

intents.I976: Cerchiamo due parti sovrapponibili senza deformazioni, anche capovolgendone una. Vorrei confrontarne forma e dimensioni.
intents.I487: Voglio mettere a confronto due pezzi triangolari adiacenti usando il tratto che hanno in comune, senza chiedere che siano uguali.
intents.I713: Vorrei capire meglio questa figura, ma non so ancora cosa confrontare.
intents.I937: Mi interessa seguire lo stesso oggetto quando fa da bordo di ciascuna parte e contemporaneamente da separazione dell’intera figura.
intents.I813: Calcolami l’area del triangolo e dammi un numero.
intents.I179: Vorrei sia leggere insieme le due parti triangolari sul tratto comune, sia seguire i diversi impieghi di quello stesso tratto nel tutto.

state.policy: Interpret each referenced user request independently. Select the smallest set of semantic perspectives covering its explicitly requested interests. Several perspectives may be useful together. Do not decide geometric feasibility: another component binds objects and checks constraints. For an unsupported task choose none; for missing focus choose clarification or retain every perspective for open exploration.
